item.title: NYC's battle of 'Hot Girls': When an Influencer’s campaign exposed Andrew Cuomo’s sexual harassment report
item.description: In the battle of "Hot Girls" during New York's mayoral race, Emily Austin’s attempt to copy the viral success of "Hot Girls for Zohran" quickly spiraled into a lesson in superficiality. While Zohran Mamdani’s movement was fueled by grassroots activism and genuine political engagement, Austin’s influencer-driven campaign was overshadowed by its lack of substance, failing to resonate with voters beyond its catchy slogan.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Away from political spotlight, Rama Duwaji, Mamdani's wife, carves a path of her own
First city in Ontario: Canada's Mississauga formally recognises anti-Hindu hate in the wake of Hinduphobic incidents
item.description: Mississauga City Council has officially recognised anti-Hindu hate, denouncing it alongside other forms of discrimination. This historic resolution follows frequent incidents like temple vandalism and harassment targeting the city's large Hindu community. The council is now directing staff to develop initiatives to counter this specific form of hate.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: How Mira Nair’s cinema shaped Zohran Mamdani’s politics
item.description: Filmmaker Mira Nair, celebrated for humanizing the marginalized, is hailed as the true architect behind her son Zohran Mamdani's historic win as New York City's first Muslim and South Asian mayor. Her decades of cinematic storytelling, championing empathy and visibility, laid the groundwork for his political philosophy of inclusion and justice, proving art can indeed shape reality.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Password for Louvre’s security system was ‘LOUVRE’ — and social media can’t stop laughing: ‘Not even L0uvr3?!’
item.description: A recent security audit of the Louvre has exposed alarming cybersecurity lapses, including a video surveillance system password of "LOUVRE." This revelation follows a brazen daylight heist of crown jewels. Reports indicate the museum has long suffered from major IT vulnerabilities, with outdated systems and weak credentials, raising serious concerns about the protection of priceless cultural heritage.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Training in Punjabi: Indian-origin duo sentenced for running fraudulent truck driving school in Canada
item.description: Two Indian-origin men, Gurvinder and Gurpreet Singh, have been convicted in Ontario for running a fraudulent truck driving training scheme. They offered sub-standard training to newcomers from South Asia for years, circumventing mandatory certification by accepting payments. The men were sentenced to house arrest for their actions, which the court noted could lead to dangerous situations on the road.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Twitch streamer Asmongold defends trans rights after years of controversial remarks
item.description: Twitch streamer Asmongold expressed support for transgender identity, stating he would respect his child's choices and prioritize their relationship over personal beliefs. This marks a notable shift from his previous anti-trans rhetoric, sparking praise and skepticism online. His comments emphasize compassion and love over ideology.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: US tests ‘doomsday’ ballistic missile days after Trump vows to restart nuclear testing after 30-year pause
item.description: The US Air Force successfully launched an unarmed Minuteman III ICBM, a test scheduled months in advance. This event follows President Trump's recent call to restart nuclear weapons testing, reigniting debate over US nuclear policy and arms control. The Minuteman III remains a crucial part of America's strategic deterrence.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UPS plane crash: Experts reveal 7 possible reasons why Kentucky cargo jet burst into flames
item.description: A UPS cargo plane crashed during takeoff from Louisville, killing at least nine and injuring 11. Experts suggest a combination of left engine failure, damage to the center engine, and a heavy fuel load likely contributed to the fiery disaster. The investigation will focus on the initial fire and potential mechanical issues.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: After ‘Dhoom Machale’ song in NYC victory speech, Mamdani's old ‘dune machale’ tweet goes viral
item.description: Bollywood's 'Dhoom Machale' soundtrack unexpectedly played at Zohran Mamdani's New York City victory speech, sparking widespread social media buzz. This resurgence brought attention to his 2021 tweet, a clever mashup of 'Dune' and the song's rhythm. The moment, amplified by his filmmaker mother Mira Nair's influence, highlighted a unique cultural confidence in politics.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Red swastikas drawn on Jewish buildings after NYC polls; mayor-elect Mamdani calls it 'disgusting act of antisemitism'
item.description: Hateful swastikas appeared on a Brooklyn yeshiva early Wednesday. This incident followed the election of Zohran Mamdani as mayor. Leaders expressed concern over rising antisemitism. Jewish groups also voiced alarm regarding Mamdani's past activism. The attack underscores growing intolerance amid high political tensions in New York City.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Man vs wild: Japan deploys military to combat deadly bear attack - Why climate change could be the reason
item.description: Japan's military has been deployed in northern regions to combat a surge in deadly bear attacks. Authorities suspect climate change is disrupting food sources, forcing bears into populated areas. Over 100 attacks and a record 12 fatalities have been reported, prompting unusual measures like military assistance and relaxed gun laws to manage the growing human-wildlife conflict.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Mamdani becomes New York City Mayor: Why its a big loss for Trump; bad sign for mid-term polls
item.description: Zohran Mamdani's historic New York City mayoral win, alongside Democratic victories in New Jersey and Virginia, signals a significant defeat for Donald Trump and his endorsed candidates. These off-year election results reflect widespread voter discontent with economic issues and Trump's policies, serving as an early warning for the Republican Party ahead of the 2026 mid-term elections.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: YouTuber Hasan Piker goes all in on Cuomo after Mamdani's win: 'I thought 'Hasan loves 9/11' was a successful campaign strategy?'
item.description: Left-wing streamer Hasan Piker celebrated Zohran Mamdani's victory over Andrew Cuomo in the New York City mayoral race. Piker, a vocal supporter of Mamdani, taunted Cuomo following the win, referencing past controversies. Cuomo's campaign had repeatedly attacked Mamdani for his association with Piker, particularly his controversial 2019 comments about 9/11.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Diaper diplomacy: Newsom’s 'baby Trump' meme goes viral after Democrats sweep key states
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom celebrated significant Democratic victories nationwide, including key races in Virginia and Georgia, and local wins in New York. Voters approved Newsom's redistricting plan, empowering Democrats to shape congressional maps. Newsom's wife, Jennifer Siebel Newsom, also strongly criticized Donald Trump, highlighting a generational shift within the Democratic Party.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Was Zohran Mamdani born in New York or in America?
item.description: New York's new progressive mayor, Zohran Mamdani, born in Uganda, highlights America's complex relationship with birthplace and belonging. While his origins bar him from the presidency, his New York upbringing defines his politics. Mamdani embodies an immigrant's perspective shaping American public life, proving identity is forged by experience, not just origin.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Sneako calls Zohran Mamdani’s campaign “the greatest since Donald Trump’s” and tells Musk to “go back to South Africa”
item.description: Internet personality Sneako praised Zohran Mamdani's mayoral campaign, calling it the greatest since Donald Trump's and highlighting Mamdani's ability to "own the internet." Sneako also criticized Elon Musk for weighing in on the New York City election, questioning his ties to the city and suggesting his comments might be motivated by Mamdani's Muslim faith.
